This product is used to treat constipation. However, milder products, such as oral laxatives, should be used whenever possible. Bisacodyl is a stimulant laxative that works by increasing the amount of fluid and salts in the intestines. This product is for rectal use only. Follow all directions on the product package or use as directed by your doctor. If you have any questions, consult your doctor or pharmacist. Wash your hands before and after using this product. Remove the foil wrapper. If desired, the suppository may be moistened with lukewarm water. Do not use petroleum jelly or mineral oil, as this may reduce the product's effectiveness. Lie on your left side with your right knee slightly bent. Gently insert the suppository, pointed end first, toward the navel and well into the rectum. Overuse of this product may lead to loss of normal bowel function and an inability to have a bowel movement without using the product, a condition known as laxative dependence. Possible side effects include rectal irritation, burning, itching, mild abdominal discomfort, cramps, or nausea. If your doctor has directed you to use this product, remember that they have determined the benefit to you outweighs the risk of side effects. Persistent diarrhea may lead to dehydration. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are rare. Before using bisacodyl, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that can cause allergic reactions or other problems. Consult your doctor before using this product if you have experienced a sudden change in bowel habits lasting more than two weeks or if you need to use a laxative for more than one week. This product may be used during labor and delivery to cleanse the bowels before the second stage of labor (pushing phase).
